posts.title: A bigger CPU number is always faster

slides.text: A bigger CPU number is always faster

posts.title: Connect your WiFi step by step

slides.text:
Connect your WiFi step by step
Click the network icon in the system tray
Click the network icon in the system tray
Pick your network name and enter the password exactly
Watch for auto-correct — passwords get mangled silently
Forget and rejoin the network if it keeps asking for the key
Still no internet? Unplug the router for 60 seconds and retry.
Save this — you'll need it next time.
